title: International travel plan
goal: Show the practical branches required to plan an international holiday.

rubric.must: International Travel Plan is visibly the central root topic.
Destination, Transport, Stay, and Itinerary visibly branch from the root.
Destination visibly expands to entry requirements and passport and visa.
Transport visibly expands to Flights and Local Mobility with planning details.
Stay and Itinerary visibly expand to accommodation, budget, priority sights, and food and culture.
At least three visual hierarchy levels are visible.
